title: Quasi-finite polynomial charts at a fibre point
statement: Let $X,T$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme; def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $f:X\to T$ locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. For every $y\in X$ there are an affine open neighborhood $U$ of $y$, an integer $n\ge0$, and a locally finitely presented, locally quasi-finite morphism $e:U\to\mathbb A^n_T$ [pqf-def-quasifinite; def-nagata-relative-affine-space] such that $e$ followed by the projection to $T$ equals $f|_U$, and the topological Krull dimension of $X_{f(y)}$ at its point corresponding to $y$ is $n$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point].

source.place: Tag 00QE, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00QE, and its affine translation in the first paragraph of the proof of Tag 00RH; read 2026-10-13.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_quasiFinite_polynomial_chart
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine T]
    (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (y : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffine U.toScheme ∧ y ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T),
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation e ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite e ∧
      e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f ∧
      topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
